faq.q: Is there a limit on how many images I can merge?
faq.a: There's no hard limit, but we recommend merging up to 20 images for best performance. Very large collages may slow down the browser preview. The final output resolution depends on your input images and the number of items.

faq.q: Will my images be uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser using the Canvas API. Your images never leave your device. No server ever receives or stores your photos.

faq.q: Can I merge images of different sizes?
faq.a: Yes. In Grid mode, images are resized to fit equal cells. In Horizontal mode, all images are scaled to the same height. In Vertical mode, all images are scaled to the same width. The tool handles different sizes automatically.
Simply drag and drop the image thumbnails in the sidebar list. The preview updates instantly to reflect the new order.

The output resolution depends on your input images and layout. Grid mode calculates cell size based on the largest image. Horizontal and Vertical modes preserve the original resolution of the first image as the reference. Very large outputs may be limited by browser canvas constraints.

faq.q: Can I remove an image after uploading?
faq.a: Yes. Each image in the sidebar has an "×" button. Click it to remove that image from the collage. You can also add more images at any time.

faq.q: Does the tool work on mobile?
faq.a: Yes. The interface is fully responsive. On mobile devices, the sidebar and canvas stack vertically. Touch-based reordering is also supported.
